column1: # Citation sigla of the Dharmaśāstra library (IAST editions, T. Lubin / P. Olivelle / SARIT style) and the
# Devanagari letter-rendering the IAST→Devanagari converter produced for them. action=restore: tools/fix_sigla.py
# puts the IAST siglum back when the rendering is followed by a number at a line start or inside [ ] ( );
# action=keep: the rendering is also a real Devanagari word or syllable (मा, वि, सं, मनु …), left untouched.
# Counts: iast_count = uses in the IAST library; deva_in_context = renderings found in the Devanagari library in a safe context.
